result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but there is one clear localization/content failure where a raw translation key is shown instead of the section title, plus a minor clipped carousel edge.

issues.description: A section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing i18n mapping or fallback so the heading renders localized text such as "Popular near you".

issues.description: The horizontal category/filter row is clipped at the right edge, with the next chip only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, keep consistent peek spacing; otherwise add right padding or adjust chip widths so the carousel edge looks deliberate.
